question: Which of the following Indian organisations successfully conducted the combat firing of the Multi-Influence Ground Mine (MIGM) in May 2025?

options.text: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited and Indian Air Force
Defence Research and Development Organisation and Indian Navy
Indian Space Research Organisation and Indian Army
Bharat Dynamics Limited and Indian Coast Guard

solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Research and Development Organisation and Indian Navy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, in collaboration with the **Indian Navy**, successfully conducted the combat firing of the **Multi-Influence Ground Mine (MIGM)** in **May 2025**.
 
• The **MIGM** is an advanced naval mine that uses multiple sensors to detect and target enemy vessels. It is a critical component of India's coastal defense strategy.
 
• The successful testing of the MIGM showcases India's growing capabilities in developing cutting-edge defense technologies indigenously.
 
• The test was conducted as part of efforts to enhance the operational readiness of the Indian Navy and ensure the security of India's maritime borders.
 
• The DRDO, a premier research and development organization under the Ministry of Defence, is responsible for developing advanced defense systems and technologies to strengthen India's self-reliance in defense production.
